column1: # What completing an activity gives a character: the player store's rewards table (d1-responder player_store).
# The original servers ran these rules server-side (game-logic DLLs, GDC 2021 "Exploring Services Architecture at
# Bungie"), so neither the client nor Bungie's public manifest holds most of them. Every row says where each value
# comes from; `stand-in` values are ours until a source turns up, and are flagged as such in the store's log.
# subs          profile field [11] completion bytes to set, SUB=VALUE (2 = completed, 1 = in progress)
# xp            XP the activity awards in all (character_level, then character_prestige past level 40)
# unlock_add / unlock_clear   unlock-flag indices (D1_UNLOCK_FLAGS) to add or clear; served from the next sign-on
# status        sourced | stand-in (any stand-in value in the row) ; source: the evidence
# TODO(rewards): A Guardian Rises' XP. The manifest names an "XP Bonus" reward (item 1315532320) with no amount;
#   900 is what the lab's post-game pushes serve, exactly level 2 on character_level's curve.
# TODO(rewards): CRUCIBLE UNLOCKED's announcement marker is one of the completion subs 912-936
#   (notes/ps4-56578-new-guardian-2026-11-03.md, rounds r4/r6); which one, and which activity sets it, is open.
# TODO(rewards): no completion here changes an unlock flag yet: no source names one.
